preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= X <= 10**9 for X, Y in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the current cleaning level X is between -10^9 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= Y <= 10**9 for X, Y in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the target cleaning level Y is between -10^9 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of output values matches the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(rounds, int) and rounds >= 0 for rounds in output)
postconditions.description: Each output value is a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of rounds.

postconditions.expression: all(rounds == 0 if X == Y else rounds > 0 for (X, Y), rounds in zip(test_cases, output))
postconditions.description: If X is already equal to Y, the number of rounds is 0; otherwise, it is positive.

postconditions.expression: all((X + a * rounds - b * (rounds - (X + a * rounds > Y))) == Y for (X, Y), rounds in zip(test_cases, output) for a in range(1, 10**9 + 1, 2) for b in range(2, 10**9 + 1, 2) if X + a * rounds - b * (rounds - (X + a * rounds > Y)) == Y)
postconditions.description: The output value represents the minimum number of rounds needed to reach the target cleaning level Y using the chosen odd a and even b.
